messages:
Grace L: kicking off onboarding for customer Nyx LoRA (nyx-lora-1). quick smoke shows cents dropped from invoice outputs in ~18% of cases. evalpack uploaded to gs://redwood-evals/nyx-invoice-quick.json :link:
Tom S: can you paste one failing example?
Grace L: prompt 0055: 'Invoice total: $7,142.99' -> model outputs '7142' (no .99) intermittently when context > 3k tokens.
Ravi: did their finetune use a custom tokenizer?
Grace L: yes, they trained with nyx_tok_patch.json but our merge applied LoRA against nyx-base tokenizer. suspect token id drift.
Tom S: run tokenmap diff: `python3 tools/tokenmap_diff.py --base models/nyx-base/tokenizer.json --other customer/tokenizers/nyx_tok_patch.json`
Tom S: diff shows punctuation and digit token ids moved (ex: `".": 58 -> 510`, `"$": 350 -> 1012`).
Ravi: remapping required. use `scripts/rebase_lora_tokenids.py --lora path/to/nyx-lora.safetensors --target customer/tokenizers/nyx_tok_patch.json --out remapped.safetensors` then rerun.
Grace L: plan: 1) fp16 baseline, 2) int4 quant without remap, 3) int4 with remap. I'll run quick-eval on dedicated test slot.
TestBot: quick-eval queued (job id ej-110201) on dedicated-gpu-5. ETA ~9m. :eyes:
Ravi: also add a smoke assertion `regex: \d+\.\d{2}` for currency fields in tests/smoke/currency_cents.test.
TestBot: job complete. results: fp16 cents preserved 99.1%, int4 w/o remap 72.0%, int4 with remap 96.0%. logs: /mnt/results/ej-110201/summary.json
Grace L: perfect  remap recovers quality. I'll open onboarding PR to auto-detect tokenizer mismatch and apply remap by default (with `--skip-rebase` opt-out). tagging @Ravi for review.
ops-bot: reservation requested for dedicated-gpu-5 2025-06-15T02:00:00Z-2025-06-15T04:00:00Z. reservation id pending.
Tom S: add a checklist item for customer finetunes: "run tokenmap diff and rebase LoRA if tokenizer differs". saved rollout. :thumbsup:
